facts.text: Karimpara Arts Foundation commissioned her suite Monsoon Ledger, later staged at the Kochi Harbour Light Festival.
Her acclaimed Chenda Counterpoint masterclass, hosted by Karimpara Arts Foundation, is funded through her Ilathalam Composers Prize.
She chairs the respected Vembanad Jazz Jury, convened by Thrissur Conservatory with the Periyar Music Trust.
With Anil Kuttippuram she leads the celebrated Backwaters Notation Project, run by Alappuzha Sound Collective.
She returns yearly to the Mattancherry Loft Sessions, programmed by Backwater Reed Records and Kochi Pier Hall.
